name: Tite Front B-Gap Pinch with Match Quarters
coverage: Cover 4 Match (Quarters Mod / Sky Safety Support)

summary.motive: Suffocate inside zone and Duo run concepts with a 3-man Tite front (404 alignment) by pinching the B-gaps, spilling the ball carrier into the waiting arms of unblocked edge defenders and downhill safeties.
summary.keyDefender: 4iL (B-gap pinch tackle) & BS (downhill alley-fitting boundary safety)
summary.whyItWorks: The 4i alignments prevent offensive tackles from climbing to the second-level linebackers, keeping the box clean while allowing the defense to play two-high pass coverage.
summary.failureMode: Quick perimeter Pin-and-Pull or Outside Zone sweep runs that reach the edge before the stand-up linebackers can set the perimeter.

beats.title: Tite Front (404 Alignment) Pre-Snap
beats.text: Chris Shula aligns in the modern 3-4 Tite front: two 4i-technique defensive tackles over the inside shoulders of the offensive tackles, a 0-tech Nose, and two stand-up edge linebackers in a two-high Quarters shell.

beats.title: Double B-Gap Pinch Clamps Inside Run
beats.text: At the snap, both 4i tackles slant violently inside into the B-gaps while the Nose controls both A-gaps. The interior run lanes are instantly choked off.

beats.title: Run Spilled Horizontally to Unblocked LOLB
beats.text: With no interior crease available, the running back is forced to bounce wide to the weak C-gap, running directly into the unblocked LOLB setting the edge.

beats.title: Boundary Safety Fills Alley for Decisive TFL
beats.text: Triggering on run action from the two-high shell, Boundary Safety (BS) sprints downhill to clean up the tackle for a 3-yard loss in the backfield.

relations.tell: 3-4 Tite front where both 4i interior linemen slant hard into the B-gaps spilling run action to perimeter OLBs and downhill safeties
